TEXT.id: 10. nisomlet do kakawan a lima no kanakan
TEXT.citation: Rau, D. V., & Dong, M. N. (2006). Yami texts with reference grammar and dictionary. Institute of Linguistics, Academia Sinica.
TEXT.BibTeX_citation: @book{rau2006yami, title={Yami texts with reference grammar and dictionary}, author={Rau, D Victoria and Dong, Maa-Neu}, year={2006}, publisher={Institute of Linguistics, Academia Sinica}}
TEXT.source: ['10. nisomlet do kakawan a lima no kanakan', '卡在礁石洞的小手', 'The hand that got stuck in the coral reefs', '', 'si apen Yohani (F, 49, Iranmilek)', '江秀玉，女，49，東清村', '']

S.FORM: ya ko i-panci am, ni-mi-gowgaw so va-vahay noka-rako no keysakan.
S.PHON: ja k[o|u] ipanci am nimig[o|u]wgaw ʂ[o|u] vavaʁaj n[o|u]karak[o|u] n[o|u] kəjʂakan
S.FORM: ya ko ipanci am, nimigowgaw so vavahay nokarako no keysakan.
S.PHON: ja k[o|u] ipanʨi am nimig[o|u]wgaw ʂ[o|u] fafaɰaj n[o|u]kaɻak[o|u] n[o|u] kəjʂakan
S.TRANSL: 我要講的是，在海水大退潮時摸洞（捉螃蟹）的故事
My story is about a person who went to catch crabs during low tide.

S.FORM: iya rana ori am, aráko o keysakan am, ma-ngay do Kasngenan do keysakan ito a.
S.PHON: ija rana [o|u]ri am ar*k[o|u] [o|u] kəjʂakan am maŋaj ɖ[o|u] kaʂŋənan ɖ[o|u] kəjʂakan it[o|u] a
S.FORM: iya rana ori am, arako o keysakan am, mangay do Kasngenan do keysakan ito a.
S.PHON: ija ɻana [o|u]ɻi am aɻak[o|u] [o|u] kəjʂakan am maŋaj ɖ[o|u] kaʂŋənan ɖ[o|u] kəjʂakan it[o|u] a
S.TRANSL: 有一天，海水退潮的時候，他就去Kasngenan海邊（捉螃蟹）
One day during low tide, he went to the sedgeland at Kasngenan to catch crabs.

S.FORM: mi-gowgaw so va-vahay am, ikongodo pangay-in na o lima na do va-vahay ori a ji máka-ngay ori am, agág-en na o lima na am, ji na rana agag-a.
S.PHON: mig[o|u]wgaw ʂ[o|u] vavaʁaj am ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u]ɖ[o|u] paŋajin na [o|u] lima na ɖ[o|u] vavaʁaj [o|u]ri a ʥi m*kaŋaj [o|u]ri am ag*gən na [o|u] lima na am ʥi na rana agaga
S.FORM: migowgaw so vavahay am, ikongodo pangayin na o lima na do vavahay ori a ji makangay ori am, agagen na o lima na am, ji na rana agaga.
S.PHON: mig[o|u]wgaw ʂ[o|u] fafaɰaj am ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u]ɖ[o|u] paŋajin na [o|u] lima na ɖ[o|u] fafaɰaj [o|u]ɻi a ʥi makaŋaj [o|u]ɻi am agagən na [o|u] lima na am ʥi na ɻana agaga
S.TRANSL: 摸洞的時候，他的手本來就進不了那個洞，但他硬是把手伸進去，結果手進了洞以後就沒辦法抽回了
When he was probing the hole, he forced his hand in and stuck it in the (small) hole; therefore, when he wanted to pull it out, he couldn't.

S.FORM: karaan am, ala to rana mi-igen o araw am, ji na pa a-hap o lima na.
S.PHON: karaan am ala t[o|u] rana miigən [o|u] araw am ʥi na pa aʁap [o|u] lima na
S.FORM: karaan am, ala to rana miigen o araw am, ji na pa ahap o lima na.
S.PHON: kaɻaan am ala t[o|u] ɻana miigən [o|u] aɻaw am ʥi na pa aɰap [o|u] lima na
S.TRANSL: 大概快到中午了吧，他的手仍無法抽出來
It was about noon, and he still hadn't pulled his hand out.

S.FORM: karaan am, to rana bazángbang rana o lima na a om-lipad am, om-lavi rana o k-anak-an ori,
S.PHON: karaan am t[o|u] rana baʐ*ŋbaŋ rana [o|u] lima na a [o|u]mlipaɖ am [o|u]mlavi rana [o|u] kanakan [o|u]ri
S.FORM: karaan am, to rana bazangbang rana o lima na a omlipad am, omlavi rana o kanakan ori,
S.PHON: kaɻaan am t[o|u] ɻana baraŋbaŋ ɻana [o|u] lima na a [o|u]mlipaɖ am [o|u]mlafi ɻana [o|u] kanakan [o|u]ɻi
S.TRANSL: 他的手紅腫了，小孩子急哭了
The child's hand had become swollen, and he started to cry

S.FORM: ta ka-teng-an na rana o ka-ji na maka-hap-an rana so lima na ori a.
S.PHON: ta katəŋan na rana [o|u] kaʥi na makaʁapan rana ʂ[o|u] lima na [o|u]ri a
S.FORM: ta katengan na rana o kaji na makahapan rana so lima na ori a.
S.PHON: ta katəŋan na ɻana [o|u] kaʥi na makaɰapan ɻana ʂ[o|u] lima na [o|u]ɻi a
S.TRANSL: 因為他知道他的手沒辦法抽出來了
because he knew he couldn't get it out.

S.FORM: ma-nakem na rana sira, ta "si mi-pono o henep ya am, apia ko ya? ji abo ka-viay ko si mi-pono o henep ya",
S.PHON: manakəm na rana ʂira ta ʂi mip[o|u]n[o|u] [o|u] ʁənəp ja am apia k[o|u] ja ʥi ab[o|u] kaviaj k[o|u] ʂi mip[o|u]n[o|u] [o|u] ʁənəp ja
S.FORM: manakem na rana sira, ta "si mipono o henep ya am, apia ko ya? ji abo kaviay ko si mipono o henep ya",
S.PHON: manakəm na ɻana ɕiɻa ta ɕi mip[o|u]n[o|u] [o|u] ɰənəp ja am apia k[o|u] ja ʥi ab[o|u] kafiaj k[o|u] ɕi mip[o|u]n[o|u] [o|u] ɰənəp ja
S.TRANSL: 他也想到，＂如果滿潮的話，我一定會死掉的，我怎麼辦？＂
"If the tide comes, what should I do? If the tide rises, I won't live!" the child thought.

S.FORM: ji rana agag do va-vahay o lima na, ta om-lipad rana ori,
S.PHON: ʥi rana agag ɖ[o|u] vavaʁaj [o|u] lima na ta [o|u]mlipaɖ rana [o|u]ri
S.FORM: ji rana agag do vavahay o lima na, ta omlipad rana ori,
S.PHON: ʥi ɻana agag ɖ[o|u] fafaɰaj [o|u] lima na ta [o|u]mlipaɖ ɻana [o|u]ɻi
S.TRANSL: 由於手已腫脹，沒辦法從洞裡抽出來了
As his hand became even more swollen, (it was wedged tightly) and couldn't slip out.

S.FORM: ta to na gowgád-an o lima na am, ori ji na rana maka-hap-i so lima na ori a.
S.PHON: ta t[o|u] na g[o|u]wg*ɖan [o|u] lima na am [o|u]ri ʥi na rana makaʁapi ʂ[o|u] lima na [o|u]ri a
S.FORM: ta to na gowgadan o lima na am, ori ji na rana makahapi so lima na ori a.
S.PHON: ta t[o|u] na g[o|u]wgaɖan [o|u] lima na am [o|u]ɻi ʥi na ɻana makaɰapi ʂ[o|u] lima na [o|u]ɻi a
S.TRANSL: 因為他一直動他的手，所以手無法抽出來
As his hand rubbed against the sides of the hole, he couldn't get it out.

S.FORM: ma-cíta na no ma-ngay do keysakan a asa ka tao a ra-rakeh ori am, "a síno ori o ya mi-pi-patotog do Kasngenan a ya mi-gi-gowgaw ori a, síno ori?"
S.PHON: mac*ta na n[o|u] maŋaj ɖ[o|u] kəjʂakan a aʂa ka ta[o|u] a rarakəʁ [o|u]ri am a ʂ*n[o|u] [o|u]ri [o|u] ja mipipat[o|u]t[o|u]g ɖ[o|u] kaʂŋənan a ja migig[o|u]wgaw [o|u]ri a ʂ*n[o|u] [o|u]ri
S.FORM: macita na no mangay do keysakan a asa ka tao a rarakeh ori am, "a sino ori o ya mipipatotog do Kasngenan a ya migigowgaw ori a, sino ori?"
S.PHON: maʨita na n[o|u] maŋaj ɖ[o|u] kəjʂakan a aʂa ka ta[o|u] a ɻaɻakəɰ [o|u]ɻi am a ɕin[o|u] [o|u]ɻi [o|u] ja mipipat[o|u]t[o|u]g ɖ[o|u] kaʂŋənan a ja migig[o|u]wgaw [o|u]ɻi a ɕin[o|u] [o|u]ɻi
S.TRANSL: 有位老人去海邊，看見了他，心想＂誰在Kasngenan那裡倒立摸洞啊？＂
An elder happened to walk toward the sea. When he saw (the child), he thought, "Who is that? Why is he upside-down with his hand in the hole?"

S.FORM: ikongodo ji na ni-ma-ziman no mi-gowgaw a k-anak-an ori o am-ian do likod na ori a ra-rakeh ori a,
S.PHON: ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u]ɖ[o|u] ʥi na nimaʐiman n[o|u] mig[o|u]wgaw a kanakan [o|u]ri [o|u] amian ɖ[o|u] lik[o|u]ɖ na [o|u]ri a rarakəʁ [o|u]ri a
S.FORM: ikongodo ji na nimaziman no migowgaw a kanakan ori o amian do likod na ori a rarakeh ori a,
S.PHON: ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u]ɖ[o|u] ʥi na nimariman n[o|u] mig[o|u]wgaw a kanakan [o|u]ɻi [o|u] amian ɖ[o|u] lik[o|u]ɖ na [o|u]ɻi a ɻaɻakəɰ [o|u]ɻi a
S.TRANSL: 由於小孩子沒有察覺到後面來了一個老人家
The child who was probing the hole didn't even notice the elder's approach from his back.

S.FORM: "tolok ka!" koan na no ra-rakeh am, ma-'ogto o k-anak-an am, mi na to na voznót-a o lima na am, mi na toda a-óyot rana o lima na,
S.PHON: t[o|u]l[o|u]k ka k[o|u]an na n[o|u] rarakəʁ am maʔ[o|u]gt[o|u] [o|u] kanakan am mi na t[o|u] na v[o|u]ʐn*ta [o|u] lima na am mi na t[o|u]ɖa a*j[o|u]t rana [o|u] lima na
S.FORM: "tolok ka!" koan na no rarakeh am, ma'ogto o kanakan am, mi na to na voznota o lima na am, mi na toda aoyot rana o lima na,
S.PHON: t[o|u]l[o|u]k ka k[o|u]an na n[o|u] ɻaɻakəɰ am maʔ[o|u]gt[o|u] [o|u] kanakan am mi na t[o|u] na f[o|u]rn[o|u]ta [o|u] lima na am mi na t[o|u]ɖa a[o|u]j[o|u]t ɻana [o|u] lima na
S.TRANSL: 結果老人＂嘟 露個＂ 一聲加上輕戳小孩屁股的動作，讓小孩子嚇得把手一抽（扯），結果就抽出來了
The elder poked the child's bottom, and the child was so frightened that he pulled up hard, and his hand came out of the hole.

S.FORM: "ayayay! ayoy ta apia rana, ayoy ta ma-hap ko rana o lima ko, ayoy ta ma-hap ko rana o lima ko".
S.PHON: ajajaj aj[o|u]j ta apia rana aj[o|u]j ta maʁap k[o|u] rana [o|u] lima k[o|u] aj[o|u]j ta maʁap k[o|u] rana [o|u] lima k[o|u]
S.FORM: "ayayay! ayoy ta apia rana, ayoy ta mahap ko rana o lima ko, ayoy ta mahap ko rana o lima ko".
S.PHON: ajajaj aj[o|u]j ta apia ɻana aj[o|u]j ta maɰap k[o|u] ɻana [o|u] lima k[o|u] aj[o|u]j ta maɰap k[o|u] ɻana [o|u] lima k[o|u]
S.TRANSL: ＂呀呀叫，痛死了；謝謝，太好了，終於把手抽出來了，謝謝，我的手抽出來了＂
At first he was crying out in pain, then he turned and said, "Thank you, thank you, this is wonderful! I finally pulled my hand out!"

S.FORM: ji na ni-'oya o ni-t-om-olok sia ori, ta i-saray na jia,
S.PHON: ʥi na niʔ[o|u]ja [o|u] nit[o|u]m[o|u]l[o|u]k ʂia [o|u]ri ta iʂaraj na ʥia
S.FORM: ji na ni'oya o nitomolok sia ori, ta isaray na jia,
S.PHON: ʥi na niʔ[o|u]ja [o|u] nit[o|u]m[o|u]l[o|u]k ɕia [o|u]ɻi ta iʂaɻaj na ʥia
S.TRANSL: 他不僅沒有責怪嚇到他，又用手指戳他屁股的老人，反而去感謝他
Not only did he not yell at the person who scared and poked him, but instead he kept on thanking him,

S.FORM: ta "ayoy ta ma-viay ko a, ayoy ta ma-viay ko a, ayoy ta ma-hap ko rana o lima ko, oyod a ma-viay ko" koan na no likey a k-anak-an ang.
S.PHON: ta aj[o|u]j ta maviaj k[o|u] a aj[o|u]j ta maviaj k[o|u] a aj[o|u]j ta maʁap k[o|u] rana [o|u] lima k[o|u] [o|u]j[o|u]ɖ a maviaj k[o|u] k[o|u]an na n[o|u] likəj a kanakan aŋ
S.FORM: ta "ayoy ta maviay ko a, ayoy ta maviay ko a, ayoy ta mahap ko rana o lima ko, oyod a maviay ko" koan na no likey a kanakan ang.
S.PHON: ta aj[o|u]j ta mafiaj k[o|u] a aj[o|u]j ta mafiaj k[o|u] a aj[o|u]j ta maɰap k[o|u] ɻana [o|u] lima k[o|u] [o|u]j[o|u]ɖ a mafiaj k[o|u] k[o|u]an na n[o|u] likəj a kanakan aŋ
S.TRANSL: ＂謝謝你，讓我能夠繼續的活著，謝謝你，終於讓我手抽出來，我真的能活著？！＂ 小孩子說
saying, "Thank you for saving me! Thank you for saving me! I finally got my hand out. I'm so glad to be alive."

S.FORM: "ka ni-ma-takzes, mo koimo ang" koan na no ra-rakeh a.
S.PHON: ka nimatakʐəʂ m[o|u] k[o|u]im[o|u] aŋ k[o|u]an na n[o|u] rarakəʁ a
S.FORM: "ka nimatakzes, mo koimo ang" koan na no rarakeh a.
S.PHON: ka nimatakrəʂ m[o|u] k[o|u]im[o|u] aŋ k[o|u]an na n[o|u] ɻaɻakəɰ a
S.TRANSL: ＂怎麼了，小鬼，有病啊！＂ 老人說
"Hey, kid, what's your problem?" the elder asked.

S.FORM: "na, yaken rana ya am, ya ni-s-om-let o lima ko am, ayoy ta mi mo yaken aviay-in a,
S.PHON: na jakən rana ja am ja niʂ[o|u]mlət [o|u] lima k[o|u] am aj[o|u]j ta mi m[o|u] jakən aviajin a
S.FORM: "na, yaken rana ya am, ya nisomlet o lima ko am, ayoy ta mi mo yaken aviayin a,
S.PHON: na jakən ɻana ja am ja niʂ[o|u]mlət [o|u] lima k[o|u] am aj[o|u]j ta mi m[o|u] jakən afiajin a
S.TRANSL: ＂哦，我呢，剛才我的手卡在洞裡了；謝謝你來救我(讓我還能活著)
"Oh, I just had my hand stuck in the hole, and thanks for saving my life.

S.FORM: ayoy ta m-owyot ko rana o lima ko a ya ni-s-om-let do va-vahay ang, ya ni-s-om-let ya do va-vahay, mo Kaminan" koan na.
S.PHON: aj[o|u]j ta m[o|u]wj[o|u]t k[o|u] rana [o|u] lima k[o|u] a ja niʂ[o|u]mlət ɖ[o|u] vavaʁaj aŋ ja niʂ[o|u]mlət ja ɖ[o|u] vavaʁaj m[o|u] kaminan k[o|u]an na
S.FORM: ayoy ta mowyot ko rana o lima ko a ya nisomlet do vavahay ang, ya nisomlet ya do vavahay, mo Kaminan" koan na.
S.PHON: aj[o|u]j ta m[o|u]wj[o|u]t k[o|u] ɻana [o|u] lima k[o|u] a ja niʂ[o|u]mlət ɖ[o|u] fafaɰaj aŋ ja niʂ[o|u]mlət ja ɖ[o|u] fafaɰaj m[o|u] kaminan k[o|u]an na
S.TRANSL: 非常感謝，我的手終於從洞裡的拔出來了。剛才我的手卡在洞裡呢，阿姨（叔叔），＂ 他說
Thanks a lot! I manged to pull my hand out that got stuck in the hole. My hand got stuck in the hold, Auntie."

S.FORM: ayoy ta m-owyot ko rana o lima ko a ya ni-s-om-let do va-vahay ang, ya ni-s-om-let ya do va-vahay, mo Maran" koan na.
S.PHON: aj[o|u]j ta m[o|u]wj[o|u]t k[o|u] rana [o|u] lima k[o|u] a ja niʂ[o|u]mlət ɖ[o|u] vavaʁaj aŋ ja niʂ[o|u]mlət ja ɖ[o|u] vavaʁaj m[o|u] maran k[o|u]an na
S.FORM: ayoy ta mowyot ko rana o lima ko a ya nisomlet do vavahay ang, ya nisomlet ya do vavahay, mo Maran" koan na.
S.PHON: aj[o|u]j ta m[o|u]wj[o|u]t k[o|u] ɻana [o|u] lima k[o|u] a ja niʂ[o|u]mlət ɖ[o|u] fafaɰaj aŋ ja niʂ[o|u]mlət ja ɖ[o|u] fafaɰaj m[o|u] maɻan k[o|u]an na
S.TRANSL: 非常感謝，我的手終於從洞裡的拔出來了。剛才我的手卡在洞裡呢，阿姨（叔叔），＂ 他說
Thanks a lot! I manged to pull my hand out that got stuck in the hole. My hand got stuck in the hold, Uncle."

S.FORM: "ayoy!" koan na am, ji rana maka-ziak ori a s-om-aray no mina ka-viay na rana, mina ka-oli do inawan na,
S.PHON: aj[o|u]j k[o|u]an na am ʥi rana makaʐiak [o|u]ri a ʂ[o|u]maraj n[o|u] mina kaviaj na rana mina ka[o|u]li ɖ[o|u] inawan na
S.FORM: "ayoy!" koan na am, ji rana makaziak ori a somaray no mina kaviay na rana, mina kaoli do inawan na,
S.PHON: aj[o|u]j k[o|u]an na am ʥi ɻana makariak [o|u]ɻi a ʂ[o|u]maɻaj n[o|u] mina kafiaj na ɻana mina ka[o|u]li ɖ[o|u] inawan na
S.TRANSL: 他高興得除了會說＂謝謝＂ 以外，別的話也想不出來了。他真的很高興撿回他自己的命
Other than "thank you," there really wasn't anything that he could say. He was very happy that he was still alive.

S.FORM: ta no mina abo o ra-rakeh ori a ni-t-om-olok sia am, ji rana to ngian do dang, ta ma-kong so wajin jia si mi-pe-hnep?
S.PHON: ta n[o|u] mina ab[o|u] [o|u] rarakəʁ [o|u]ri a nit[o|u]m[o|u]l[o|u]k ʂia am ʥi rana t[o|u] ŋian ɖ[o|u] ɖaŋ ta mak[o|u]ŋ ʂ[o|u] waʥin ʥia ʂi mipəʁnəp
S.FORM: ta no mina abo o rarakeh ori a nitomolok sia am, ji rana to ngian do dang, ta makong so wajin jia si mipehnep?
S.PHON: ta n[o|u] mina ab[o|u] [o|u] ɻaɻakəɰ [o|u]ɻi a nit[o|u]m[o|u]l[o|u]k ɕia am ʥi ɻana t[o|u] ŋian ɖ[o|u] ɖaŋ ta mak[o|u]ŋ ʂ[o|u] waʥin ʥia ɕi mipəɰnəp
S.TRANSL: 因為如果沒有那個老人的＂指戳＂ 舉動，他一定淹死在那裡，因為若是滿潮了的話，他哪有辦法脫困
If the old man had not poked him, he would have drowned at the high tide because there was no way to get out.

S.FORM: am ori ni-saray-an na nia no likey a k-anak-an do ra-rakeh a ni-t-om-olok sia ori a, ha ha ha.
S.PHON: am [o|u]ri niʂarajan na nia n[o|u] likəj a kanakan ɖ[o|u] rarakəʁ a nit[o|u]m[o|u]l[o|u]k ʂia [o|u]ri a ʁa ʁa ʁa
S.FORM: am ori nisarayan na nia no likey a kanakan do rarakeh a nitomolok sia ori a, ha ha ha.
S.PHON: am [o|u]ɻi niʂaɻajan na nia n[o|u] likəj a kanakan ɖ[o|u] ɻaɻakəɰ a nit[o|u]m[o|u]l[o|u]k ɕia [o|u]ɻi a ɰa ɰa ɰa
S.TRANSL: 這就是小孩子感激老人的＂指戳＂ 他的原因。哈，哈，哈
Therefore the child was thankful that the elder poked him. Ha ha ha (laughing).

S.FORM: "oyod a ji ko a-viay ya" koan no likey a k-anak-an am, ori to na laví-i a om-gona-gonay so lima na ori am,
